suggested_requirements.text: The system shall comply with the list of normative documents for all GSM services necessary to provide the functionality specified in the EIRENE FRS.
The network shall provide a coverage probability of 95% based on a coverage level of 38.5 dBµV/m for voice and non-safety critical data.
The network shall provide a coverage probability of 95% based on a coverage level of 41.5 dBµV/m on lines with ETCS levels 2/3 for speeds lower than or equal to 220km/h.
The EIRENE mobile installation shall be designed to operate in a network meeting the specified coverage criteria.
Call setup times as defined in the EIRENE FRS shall be achieved with authentication and ciphering procedures enabled.
The network shall operate in a sub-band, or combination of sub-bands, of the R-GSM band.
The network shall use the frequency convention Fl(n) = 890 + 0.2*(n-1024) for carriers in the UIC frequency band where 955 ≤ n ≤ 973.
The network shall terminate the ongoing VGCS/VBS call if it receives the 3-digit sequence '***' transmitted via DTMF signals.
The fixed line dispatcher shall generate a DTMF tone duration of 70ms ± 5ms.
The fixed line dispatcher shall provide a minimum gap of 65ms between each DTMF tone.
The network shall send the SET-PARAMETER message with the attribute 'D-ATT = T' to the mobile station of the talking subscriber if it receives the 3-digit sequence '## #' transmitted via DTMF.
The network shall send the SET-PARAMETER message with the attribute 'D-ATT = T' to the mobile station of the talking subscriber if it receives the group call SETUP message from a controller terminal.

The network shall send the SET-PARAMETER message with the attribute 'D-ATT = F' to the mobile of the talking subscriber only if it has received the 3-digit sequence '# **' transmitted via DTMF from all the talking controllers.
The duration of each tone added in the voice channel shall be 70ms ± 5ms.
The network shall provide a minimum gap of 65ms between each tone in the voice channel.
All SIM cards used in EIRENE mobiles shall comply with the requirements of the MORANE FFFIS for GSM-R SIM Cards.
All mobiles shall be capable of operation in the Railway GSM (R-GSM) frequency band (876-915/921-960 MHz).
The mobile radio antenna installation on vehicles shall be designed to ensure that mobiles operate correctly in networks conforming to design criteria.
Cab radios shall be of power class 2 (8W).
General purpose radios shall be of power class 4 (2W).
Operational radios shall be of power class 4 (2W).
The EIRENE radio shall automatically re-attempt the Railway emergency call setup until the call setup is successful, a 30-second retry timer expires, or the user abandons the call.
A service availability indication shall be provided to radio users.
The system shall prevent the user from entering direct mode if the GSM service is available.
The system shall provide an indication to the user of the status of the establishment request procedure if a Railway emergency call setup is not successful after 2 seconds.
All EIRENE mobile equipment shall comply with environmental, EMC and physical specifications defined in the GSM standard.
All EIRENE mobile equipment shall conform to EN 60950 (Safety of Information Technology Equipment).
All design, manufacturing, testing and installation of EIRENE mobile radio equipment shall comply with ISO 9001 quality procedures.
EIRENE mobile equipment shall be capable of operating over a standard range of temperatures from -20°C to +55°C.
EIRENE mobile equipment shall be capable of being stored at temperatures down to -40°C without any permanent damage.
The equipment shall be capable of coping with temperature variations of up to +/- 1°C/minute.
EIRENE mobile equipment shall be capable of operating between altitudes of -100m and 1800m.
The equipment shall be able to cope with relative humidities of 100% for short periods.
The equipment shall cope with 95% humidity for 30 days in the year.
Operationally caused infrequent and slight moisture condensation shall not lead to any malfunction or failure.
All equipment shall not degrade photochemically when exposed to solar radiation of up to 1200 W/m2.
All EIRENE mobile equipment shall be protected against shock and vibration in compliance with standards defined in prEN 50125.
All handheld mobile equipment shall be capable of withstanding non-repetitive shocks of up to 3g for up to 100ms.
All handheld mobile equipment shall be capable of withstanding free fall from 0.5m.
EIRENE mobile equipment shall be capable of being subjected to both sinusoidal and random vibration.
